description: This file defines classes related to Wi-Fi Access Point operational BSS information, including classes for radio info, BSS info, and the main tlvApOperationalBSS class, with methods for managing and serializing this data.

classes.name: tlvApOperationalBSS
classes.description: Represents the Wi-Fi Access Point operational BSS, manages radio list data.

classes.name: cRadioInfo
classes.description: Contains information about a radio, including its UID and BSS list.

classes.name: cRadioBssInfo
classes.description: Contains BSS-specific information such as BSSID and SSID.

methods.name: tlvApOperationalBSS
methods.description: Constructor initializing from buffer or shared pointer.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the TLV.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the TLV.

methods.name: radio_list_length
methods.description: Returns the length of the radio list.

methods.name: create_radio_list
methods.description: Creates a new radio info object.

methods.name: add_radio_list
methods.description: Adds a radio info object to the list.

methods.name: get_initial_size
methods.description: Returns the initial size of the object.
